subject: english
question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word from the underlined words in the following sentence.

Communities must build their __resileince__, including adopting __appropriate__ technologies while making the most of traditional knowledge, and __diversifying__ their __livelihoods__ to cope with current and future climate stress.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. **"resileince".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **incorrectly **spelled word is "**resileince**". The **correct **spelling is "**resilience**".
 
• **Resilience **(लचीलापन) - The ability of a person, community, or system to withstand or recover quickly from difficult conditions.
 
 
• **Example**: The community's resilience in the aftermath of the natural disaster was truly inspiring.
 
 
 
• The other words in the sentence are correctly spelt.

Therefore, the correct answer is "resileince". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Livelihoods **(जीविका) - The means by which an individual or family supports themselves financially and economically.
 
• **Diversifying **(विविधीकरण) - The process of increasing variety through adding different elements or components to something.
 
• **Appropriate** (उपयुक्त) - Suitable or proper in the circumstances.
